build_rtmdet_model: build an RTMDet-ins small object detection model config inheriting from the large variant for COCO
create_train_pipeline: create a training data pipeline with mosaic, random crop, mixup, and YOLOX HSV augmentation for RTMDet
test_train_pipeline_stage2: test the stage 2 training pipeline that switches after epoch 280 without mosaic and mixup
run_ema_custom_hook: run an EMA hook with exponential momentum 0.0002 to update model buffers during training
configure_rtmdet_backbone: configure the RTMDet CSPNeXt backbone with deepen factor 0.33 and widen factor 0.5
